mechanism: Construct a separate resource proposal class from actual occupied crossings and wire detours of slack-bearing noncritical branches; then test their release alone and before critical/near-critical repair in a private sequentially updated transaction.
potential_diagnostic: Count actual per-net unique SB pairs, CB crossing output sources and planar wire from existing audited routes; compare terminal-layer cut requirements and observed crossing excursions. Layer-only cut requirements are an optimistic structural reference, not a feasible routing algorithm or global timing/resource optimum. SB and CB may substitute, so do not give each a separate unqualified lower bound.

Check whether high-resource slack-bearing branches actually hold capacity on the relaxed critical/near-critical alternative paths; state the reachable donor set and unknowns before expensive whole-router trials.
selection_rule: Uniform objective-specific rankings from current state (marginal resource release, downstream slack, actual scarce-resource overlap), never per-circuit historical best; protect current critical/near-critical retained branches and compare the same scope/opportunity in native controls.
implementation_plan: New resource-opportunity analyzer reusing immutable RRG mapping and current route/resource owners; no change to runningv3 or its frozen request menus.

Independent candidate interface with explicit resource objective and fixed timing/hold requirements. Use real physical Tdel, capacity updates after each connection, original sink/retained-branch legality, whole FULLSTA and atomic accept/rollback.

Small path Pareto/penalty queries may use delay as feasibility screen; record nondominated-label/query caps as per-query resource guards and retain unknown status, never a research termination condition.

If native weighted searches choose identical routes, fold implementations and attribute benefit to selector/schedule; if a new resource cost changes routes, compare resource-only, timing-only and combination under the same domain/tree/acceptance opportunities.
falsifiers_and_actions: No feasible alternative crossing/wire on exposed slack branches: quantify the restriction and shift scope or donor/receiver assignment; do not repeat neighboring penalty values without new mechanism evidence.
Resource release exists but does not reach scarce resources or key timing cones: retain feasible resource Pareto candidates and revise critical-overlap scheduling.
Combined release/repair helps while isolated components do not improve CPD: retain the combination and validate dependencies with matching ablations.
requirements: Define common absolute design envelopes for matched strongA0/R1/Tf; preserve strict CPD comparator and own-current states, classify full runtime unknown until a complete configuration flow is measured.
